address: Le K2 Chogori, 143 avenue du Prariond, Val-d'Isère, 73150, France
bio: We may be in the Alps, but this place fêtes an entirely different mountain range – the Andes! The culinary offering here is inspired by Peruvian history and cuisine: think barbecued specialities, condiments, dishes for sharing etc. Be transported to Peru, without even leaving this chic, intimate and friendly setting....
